name: DataList
summary: Key/value or item list for structured data.

a11y.apg: No APG pattern and no keyboard: it is a real <dl>, so the pairing between term and value lives in the markup and survives with the stylesheet off.

props.name: items
props.description: Term and value pairs, rendered as a real <dl>. The pairing is in the markup, so it survives with the stylesheet off and reads correctly to a screen reader.
